title: Bayes' theorem (cited)
primary_statement: P(B_j|A) = P(A|B_j)P(B_j) / sum_i P(A|B_i)P(B_i) -- math-probability:bayes_theorem

title: Likelihood function (cited)
primary_statement: L(theta) = prod_i f(x_i; theta) -- math-statistics:likelihood_function

title: Conjugate prior (cited)
primary_statement: a prior family closed under the likelihood -- math-statistics:conjugate_prior

title: Bayes estimator (cited)
primary_statement: the decision rule minimizing posterior expected loss -- math-statistics:bayes_estimator

title: Posterior mean under squared loss (cited)
primary_statement: Bayes estimator under squared loss is E[theta|x] -- math-statistics:posterior_mean_rule

title: Credible interval (cited)
primary_statement: P(theta in C(x) | x) = 1 - alpha -- math-statistics:credible_interval

title: Bernstein-von Mises theorem (cited)
primary_statement: posterior is asymptotically N(theta_hat, (nI)^-1); credible sets get frequentist coverage -- math-statistics:bernstein_von_mises

title: Coverage probability (cited)
primary_statement: P_theta(theta in C(X)) as a function of theta -- math-statistics:coverage_probability

title: z-interval for a normal mean (cited)
primary_statement: Xbar +- z_{1-alpha/2} sigma/sqrt(n) -- math-statistics:normal_mean_ci_known_variance

title: Likelihood ratio test (cited)
primary_statement: reject H0 for small Lambda = sup_{Theta_0} L / sup_{Theta} L -- math-statistics:likelihood_ratio_test

title: Bernoulli distribution (cited)
primary_statement: P(X=1)=p, P(X=0)=1-p -- math-probability:bernoulli_distribution

title: Beta distribution (cited)
primary_statement: f(x) prop x^(a-1)(1-x)^(b-1) on [0,1] -- math-probability:beta_distribution

title: Normal distribution (cited)
primary_statement: f(x) prop exp(-(x-mu)^2/(2 sigma^2)) -- math-probability:normal_distribution

title: Gamma distribution (cited)
primary_statement: f(x) prop x^(a-1) e^(-b x) on (0,infinity) -- math-probability:gamma_distribution

title: Poisson distribution (cited)
primary_statement: P(X=k) = e^-lambda lambda^k / k! -- math-probability:poisson_distribution

title: Prior distribution
primary_statement: a distribution pi(theta) over the parameter representing pre-data belief

title: Posterior proportional to prior times likelihood
primary_statement: pi(theta|x) prop pi(theta) L(theta); the missing normalizer is the marginal likelihood

title: Worked conjugate families
primary_statement: Beta-Bernoulli, Normal-Normal (known variance), Gamma-Poisson: closed-form posterior updates

title: Marginal likelihood
primary_statement: p(x) = integral L(theta) pi(theta) d theta, the normalizer omitted by proportionality

title: Bayes factor
primary_statement: BF_10 = p(x|M1) / p(x|M0), the ratio of marginal likelihoods

title: Jeffreys scale
primary_statement: conventional strength-of-evidence bins for log10(BF_10): barely worth mentioning / substantial / strong / decisive

title: Bayesian model comparison via Bayes factors
primary_statement: posterior odds = Bayes factor times prior odds; compares models without a nested-hypothesis requirement

title: Lindley's paradox
primary_statement: a diffuse-enough prior on M1 makes the Bayes factor favor M0 at data a classical test rejects at the same significance

title: Credible interval vs. confidence interval
primary_statement: same nominal coverage under a flat prior on the normal mean, different interpretation; Bernstein-von Mises explains the asymptotic coincidence
